findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_listing, lint_endpoint, check_payee, check_endpoint · Private data: domain_auth, seller_index, wallet_statement, check_token, lint_endpoint, check_payee, preflight_payment, check_endpoint · Public sink: lint_endpoint, preflight_payment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_listing, lint_endpoint, check_payee, check_endpoint · Private data: domain_auth, seller_index, wallet_statement, check_token, lint_endpoint, check_payee, preflight_payment, check_endpoint · Public sink: lint_endpoint, preflight_payment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_payee" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
